ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the amount of money involved and the individuals and organizations implicated
questions: How much money is involved in child care fraud?
Who are the key players in the scandal?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal a complex web of financial transactions and relationships between individuals and organizations. This investigation could lead to a deeper understanding of the scope and impact of child care fraud in Minnesota.
